surfaces.label: First-run and existing-vault scan
surfaces.note: Selects an existing folder, scans it read-only and exposes local compatibility state.

surfaces.label: Unsupported extension report
surfaces.note: Unsupported and symlink entries remain visible without becoming editable targets.

surfaces.label: Extension trust and enablement
surfaces.handoff: Owner: compatibility-runtime. Prerequisite: unchanged pinned extension bundles and a provisioned runtime; certify mediated enablement or record a D15 denial.

surfaces.label: Provider setup
surfaces.note: Managed, BYOK and local modes are explicit and show unavailable state without silent fallback.

surfaces.label: Source inspector
surfaces.note: Citation excerpts show path, heading, line range, revision and a no-model-inference label before opening source.

surfaces.label: Multi-file diff
surfaces.note: Chronicle review selects files and switches between aggregate and per-path diffs.

surfaces.label: Conflict resolver
surfaces.note: Preserved incoming bytes are inspectable before an explicit current/incoming resolution.

surfaces.label: History and restore
surfaces.note: Chronicle commits and local recovery records remain visible with revision-checked restore actions.

surfaces.label: Settings search
surfaces.note: Settings sections are filterable without changing persisted values.

surfaces.label: Keyboard shortcuts
surfaces.note: Command palette, quick switcher and save shortcuts have visible entry points and a searchable command list.

surfaces.label: Model and download management
surfaces.handoff: Owner: ai-retrieval. Prerequisite: local model runtime, hardware matrix and download/storage authority; certify integrity, offline, reindex and derivative cleanup behavior.

surfaces.label: Account and billing
surfaces.handoff: Owner: managed-service/backend operations. Prerequisite: authorized managed endpoint, account/entitlement contract and billing policy; no paid provisioning is enabled in this client.

surfaces.label: Safe mode and extension bisect
surfaces.handoff: Owner: operations-handoff. Prerequisite: packaged crash restart and extension-disable harness; validate safe-mode launch and bisect without deleting vault data.

surfaces.label: Privacy-preserving diagnostics
surfaces.note: The local manifest excludes note content, provider secrets and absolute paths.
